#UPDATED 2026-08-19: ids whose primitive is now grade=unsupported were removed - an
#unsupported card is filtered out of the collection, so forcing it into play by id yields
#a null card. That is a property of this test method, not a real-play risk.
#Auto-generated load guard 23: puts HOB/HOC permanents into play to prove the
#engine can construct and resolve them. This catches the FATAL failure mode --
#an unrecognised phase/trigger name yields a null card and kills the engine in
#TestSuiteGame::initGame (Spell(observer, NULL)), as Beorn the Fierce did.
#Cards are referenced by id because many HOB/HOC names contain commas and the
#zone parser splits on commas.
#NOTE: the asserted counts are RECORDED CURRENT BEHAVIOUR, not verified-correct
#rules behaviour. This guards against crashes and silent card-load failure, not
#against a card doing the wrong thing.
#Covers: Inferno Titan, Iron Hills, Iron Hills Blacksmith, Iron Hills Stalwart, Island, Ithilien Kingfisher
[INIT]
firstmain
[PLAYER1]
inplay:701198,700185,700016,700190,701177
[PLAYER2]
life:20
[DO]
next
[ASSERT]
COMBATBEGIN
[PLAYER1]
inplay:*,*,*,*,*,*
[PLAYER2]
life:20
[END]
